content.text: Digital creators often face severe limitations due to restrictions on conventional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal, particularly in regions such as Nigeria and Zimbabwe. This guide focuses on using Supabase as your order database to set up a fully operational digital store. You will learn how to deploy your infrastructure, process [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-11|Crypto Payment]] [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-what-actually-how-10|COREMERCH guide to payments]]-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-16|payments]], and manage product delivery, all without relying on traditional payment gateways.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

When conventional platforms fail, they hinder the potential of digital creators. COREMERCH's infrastructure provides an alternative that prioritizes sovereignty. By leveraging GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages along with NOWPayments, you ensure ownership of your data and infrastructure. This architecture circumvents the restrictions often imposed by payment platforms, allowing you to operate with complete control. The result is an efficient, reliable solution that empowers creators to transact freely and directly with their audience.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deployment, gather essential components. For Stack 01, you will need a GitHub account to host your pages and a Google account for Apps Script. If you choose Stack 02, set up a Cloudflare account for Pages and Workers, and a Supabase account for your order database. Familiarize yourself with NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Ensure you have your digital products ready for upload, as you'll need to configure them during the setup process. Understanding these tools lays the foundation for a successful deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your backend. For Stack 01, use GitHub Pages to host your store's front end, then implement Google Apps Script for backend logic. Integrate NOWPayments for seamless crypto payment processing. If you're opting for Stack 02, deploy Cloudflare Pages and Workers, and configure your Supabase database for order management. Test your payment systems thoroughly to ensure that transactions process correctly and that product delivery is automated. Effective setup here is crucial for a smooth customer experience.
Infrastructure sovereignty is key; you own everything post-deployment.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After completing your setup, it's time to go live. Launch your store and start promoting it across your channels. Use your unique URLs to direct traffic to your GitHub or Cloudflare hosted site. Monitor your first transactions closely. With NOWPayments, you will receive confirmation of payments almost instantly. Ensure that your product delivery system is functioning smoothly, allowing customers to access their purchases seamlessly. This is where the infrastructure you built comes to fruition, enabling you to transact and deliver efficiently.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your store is operational, consider scaling your offerings. With Stack 02, you can handle up to five products, but as your sales grow, you might want to expand your catalog. Leverage Supabase to manage larger datasets and keep track of orders, customers, and inventory effectively. Additionally, continue engaging with your audience to understand their needs. Optimize your marketing efforts to drive traffic and sales. Growth is achievable with the solid foundation you've established.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, utilize platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, and integrate NOWPayments for payment processing. With COREMERCH's Stack 01 or Stack 02, you can deploy a fully functional store without relying on conventional payment gateways, ensuring true ownership and sovereignty for your business.
No subscriptions or hidden fees; just your store and your products.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create accounts on GitHub and Google for Stack 01, or Cloudflare and Supabase for Stack 02. 2. Prepare your digital products for upload. 3. Deploy your hosting solution using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 4. Implement Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for processing crypto payments. 6. Test the entire system thoroughly. 7. Launch your store and begin promoting your offerings.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up my digital store on GitHub Pages?

To set up your digital store on GitHub Pages, create a repository for your store, upload your product files, and configure the settings to enable GitHub Pages. Use Google Apps Script for backend management and integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, while Stack 02 utilizes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. Stack 02 supports more products and offers advanced features like end-to-end testing and configuration support.
Can I host a digital product store on Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, Cloudflare Pages is an excellent choice for hosting a digital product store. It provides fast performance, easy deployment, and integrates well with backend services like Supabase and NOWPayments for effective order management and payment processing.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept a wide range of digital currencies. This flexibility ensures that you can cater to diverse customer preferences and expand your market reach.
Is there ongoing support after deployment?
Yes, with the Edge Commerce Stack, you receive 30-day support post-deployment. This ensures that you have assistance as you transition to managing your digital store independently.
